title: Line break in link destination
message: An inline link destination cannot contain a line break.
hints: Remove the line break inside the link's `(...)` destination and keep the URL on a single line.

cases.name: after-scheme
cases.description: Newline immediately after the scheme `://` of an inline link destination.

cases.name: mid-destination
cases.description: Newline within the host portion of an inline link destination.

cases.name: before-close-paren
cases.description: Newline immediately before the closing `)` of an inline link destination.
